# KataGo Remote One-Click v0.1.5

Makes the tunnel transport more reliable on networks that throttle UDP.

## Changes

- **http2 by default**: named tunnels now start cloudflared with `TUNNEL_TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL=http2` (TCP 443). In practice this stops the repeated `connIndex=N ... control stream encountered a failure` / `failed to run the datagram handler` warnings that QUIC produces on some networks. The performance difference is negligible for analysis traffic.
- **Configurable**: `katago-remote init --tunnel-protocol quic` switches back to QUIC, and `--tunnel-protocol auto` lets cloudflared choose. The installer accepts `KATAGO_REMOTE_TUNNEL_PROTOCOL=http2|quic|auto`.
- Existing configurations without `tunnelProtocol` are treated as `http2`, so upgrades get the new default automatically.

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -fsSLo /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykrsama/katago-remote-one-click/v0.1.5/install.sh
bash /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh
```

Existing KataGo files, fixed-hostname settings, private links, and the Human SL model are reused.
